rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for expressing a very high degree, as in being acutely aware.

example.english: I am acutely aware of what I want.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 cing1 co2 zi6 gei2 soeng2 jiu3 mat1

rows.note: Use this for a strong degree in a somewhat more emphatic or formal-sounding expression than 好.

example.english: We are acutely concerned about this issue.
example.traditional: 我哋非常關注呢個問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 fei1 soeng4 gwaan1 zyu3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
